candidateEvidence.excerpt: OpenAI says it temporarily paused new sign-ups and upgrades to ChatGPT Pro $200, also called Pro 20X, on September 10. Pro 20X is OpenAI’s name for its ChatGPT Pro $200 tier. The pause applies if you are on Free, Go, Plus or Pro $100 and want to move into Pro $200.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: As of September 10, 2026, we’re temporarily pausing new sign-ups and upgrades to the ChatGPT Pro $200 plan (Pro 20X). This includes sign-ups and upgrades from Free, Go, Plus, or Pro $100. Existing ChatGPT Pro $200 subscriptions and new or existing ChatGPT Pro $100 subscriptions are not affected by this pause. You can upgrade to Pro $100 from the Pricing page, but you cannot upgrade to the Pro $200 plan.

No. Existing Pro $200 subscriptions continue to renew as usual. If you subscribe through chatgpt.com and your renewal payment fails, we will send you an email with options to renew the account; if you take no action and your subscription is canceled, you cannot purchase Pro $200 again until the pause is lifted. If you schedule a downgrade from Pro $200 to Pro $100, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle. You keep Pro $200 until then. If a cancellation is scheduled but your Pro $200 subscription is still active, you keep Pro $200 until the end of your current billing cycle. If the cancellation takes effect and your account moves to Free, you cannot purchase Pro $200 again until the pause is lifted.
